look: Sathya's AI for Real Life collage reel series: white paper-texture wall with grey vignette and drifting window / spot / soft light; full-colour pop-art sticker cut-outs pinned with heavy soft drop shadows; brand accents pink #FB3779 and blue #3C46FD only; pro camera rig travelling a tall world with parallax back plane, handheld drift, dutch tilts, snap punch-ins and whip cuts; Morven kicker over huge Allenoire headlines with random-letter reveals, Regarn Black tapes, stamps and nodes, hand-drawn pink wires and arrows; a ghost outline word behind every scene; AI for Real Life logo end card. Fonts are Sathya's files: Allenoire-400, Morven-400, Regarn 100/400/700/900. Instagram Reel 9:16, cut to the 25 Nov 2026 ternary-weights script's timecodes, no voice-over, SFX-only score, text inside the Reels safe zone. rich

scenes.name: Both are real
scenes.desc: Two pinned rows on the paper wall: a model file at 5.9 GB in pink and 27 B parameters in blue; a stamp slams BOTH ARE REAL over a floppy disk.

scenes.name: Sixteen bits
scenes.desc: One weight typed out as a long sixteen-bit decimal inside a paper panel, inspected under a magnifier; the label reads one weight, full precision.

scenes.name: Fifty four
scenes.desc: A pink counter climbs to 54 GB as three servers drop in; the tag reads before any of your own code.

scenes.name: Sign only
scenes.desc: The long decimal crumples and three filled blocks land: minus one in pink, zero in ink, plus one in blue.

scenes.name: A direction
scenes.desc: A grid of 128 cells fills in one by one, each holding a pink minus, a blue plus or a grey dot; a tape reads 128 weights beside a chip.

scenes.name: One scale factor
scenes.desc: A panel holds one shared scale factor, 0.0412, and a drawn pink arrow carries it down into the grid; the headline reads under two bits, against sixteen.

scenes.name: During training
scenes.desc: Top half: a hammer lands on a model rounded afterwards and a pink crack runs across it. The camera tilts to the lower half, where cells settle into the lattice beside a brain and a stamp reads NOT BOLTED ON.

scenes.name: Verified
scenes.desc: Two bars grow from one baseline, 75.6 in pink for the ternary model against 80.6 in blue for full precision, under a kicker naming PrismML's own SWE-bench Verified run and a tag reading no independent test yet.

scenes.name: Your own hardware
scenes.desc: A laptop with a drawn pink cable that a plug is pulled clear of; the headline reads on your own hardware and the tag reads open weight, Apache 2.0.

scenes.name: Costs in bits
scenes.desc: Back on the opening rows: the parameter row fades back while 5.9 GB stays lit, under the line ask what each one costs in bits.

scenes.name: AI for Real Life
scenes.desc: End card: the AI for Real Life logo pops onto the brand blue.
